source: https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/arrivalcard/ (SG Arrival Card web form: date handling, arrival-date options and field validators read from its front-end, 2026-10-15)

passport.label: Passport number
passport.help: Printed on the photo page of your passport. Letters and digits, up to 20.

errors.tooLong: Passport number too long — max 20 characters
errors.invalidChars: Letters and numbers only — no spaces or symbols
errors.invalidFormat: Letters and digits only, up to 20

full_name.label: Full name (as in passport)
full_name.help: Given names followed by surname, as the form prompts. Up to 66 characters, starting with a letter: letters, spaces and ' / . ( ) - @ , only.

errors.invalidChars: Start with a letter; letters, spaces and ' / . ( ) - @ , only

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: DD/MM/YYYY, as the SG Arrival Card uses it. It cannot be later than today (Singapore time).

errors.tooEarly: Date of birth seems too far in the past — double check
errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be later than today

passport_expiry.label: Passport expiry date
passport_expiry.help: DD/MM/YYYY. Check ICA passport-validity requirements for your travel document; Singapore passport holders have different requirements from foreign visitors.

errors.tooEarly: Passport must be valid at least 6 months after arrival

flight_number.label: Flight or vessel number
flight_number.help: Pick the airline code (e.g. SQ) from the form's list; the flight-number box takes digits only, so SQ32 is entered as SQ + 32.

errors.invalidFormat: Digits only — the airline code is picked separately

arrival_date.label: Arrival date
arrival_date.help: DD/MM/YYYY — the date you arrive in Singapore. The form lists today and the next 2 days (Singapore time) to choose from.

errors.tooEarly: Arrival date cannot be in the past
errors.tooLate: The SG Arrival Card opens 3 days before arrival — come back closer to the date

accommodation.label: Address in Singapore
accommodation.help: Hotel name and address. For Singapore residents, use your home address.
